description: `relative_memberships` carries confirmed current/deceased relative membership scoped to one exact target credit union; one institution is never reused for another. Check whether a user can JOIN specific credit unions (field-of-membership eligibility). Batch-friendly: pass 1-50 credit_union_ids (from get_financing_decision offers, list_credit_unions, or get_credit_union) plus whatever is known about the user (home, worksite, and payroll geography are independent facts; employer, occupation, military_status, school plus school_relationship, and worship are also supported). City facts require their same-role state or a recognized same-role ZIP that uniquely identifies one state, and are accepted only when the closed Census gazetteer resolves them. Returns one row for every requested credit union. Positive outcomes include open_to_anyone, likely_eligible, eligible_via_employer, and eligible_via_military. A school name alone is not a positive signal: school_relationship is required to affirm a typed student, alumni, or school-employee path. Only a graph carrying exact active-publication lineage governs the top compatibility verdict; a publication-less shadow graph remains diagnostic and cannot replace the flat result. A non-match is returned as unknown, with `unknown_reason: fom_completeness_unaffirmed` when the published field-of-membership corpus is not attested complete. The legacy `geo_mismatch` enum value is reserved for wire compatibility and is not emitted by this MCP boundary without a future typed closed-world attestation. Verdicts are guidance based on each credit union's published membership criteria; the final membership determination is always the institution's. Non-matches carry `missing_facts` for the named institutions: the exact question to ask next, the `fact_field` an answer populates, and the institution's own words. A check that returns unknown for all of them and a question for each is a SUCCESSFUL call, not a failure — ask the questions, merge the answers into the same request, and call again. Home geography accepts both the original `zip`/`state`/`county` names and the `home_zip`/`home_state`/`home_county` aliases emitted by `missing_facts`; do not send conflicting values in both forms. Fact fields, in full — supply every one you know: `home_zip`, `home_state`, `home_county`, `home_city`; `work_zip`, `work_state`, `work_county`, `work_city`; `payroll_zip`, `payroll_state`, `payroll_county`, `payroll_city` (payroll can differ from the worksite and is a separate door); `property_zip`, `property_state`, `property_county`, `property_city` (where they OWN property — never inferred from where they live, and an absentee owner qualifies); `facility_zip`, `facility_state`, `facility_county`, `facility_city` (where their business maintains a location); `occupation`; `employer`; `school` plus `school_relationship` (student/alumni/employee — a school name without a relationship affirms nothing); `military_status` plus `military_service_state` (state National Guard doors need the state); `worship`; `family_relation` plus `relative_employers`, `relative_schools`, `relative_associations` (a great many people qualify only through a relative — ask); `applicant_kind` (person/trust/organization/partnership/corporation — some charters admit entities, and a person is never rejected by an entity-only door, only left unknown); and `asserted_org_qualifiers` (narrowings the person asserts about themselves, e.g. "assigned as a recruiter in Arkansas").

applicant_kind.description: What the applicant IS. Some charters admit entities as well as people. Absent means a natural person; a person is never rejected by an entity-only door, only left unknown.

asserted_org_qualifiers.description: Narrowings the user asserts about themselves, quoted back from a missing_facts question (e.g. "assigned as Recruiters or ROTC Instructors within the State of Arkansas"). Absence caps a narrowed door rather than closing it.

association_org_ids.description: Canonical association ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities; each is type- and publication-revalidated.

county.description: User's home county for residence matching. Original name; home_county is an equivalent merge-and-retry alias.

credit_union_ids.description: Credit union ids to check (1-50), e.g. from get_financing_decision offers or list_credit_unions. Required.

employer.description: User's employer, matched against credit union employer/SEG membership lists.

employer_org_ids.description: Canonical employer ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities. The API revalidates entity type and active-publication authority before use.

facility_city.description: Census-recognized city where the user's business maintains a location. Requires facility_state or a recognized facility_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

facility_county.description: County where the user's business maintains a location.

facility_state.description: State where the user's business maintains a location.

facility_zip.description: ZIP where the user's business maintains a location. Distinct from the worksite ZIP.

family_relation.description: How the user relates to a RELATIVE whose own affiliations may qualify them (e.g. 'spouse', 'child', 'immediate family'). Required alongside relative_employers/relative_schools/relative_associations — without it there is nobody for those organizations to belong to. Many SEG lists read 'Employees of the following companies AND THEIR IMMEDIATE FAMILIES are eligible'; this is how that door is answered.

home_city.description: User's Census-recognized home city. Requires state or a recognized zip that uniquely identifies one state; unresolved labels are rejected rather than guessed.

home_county.description: Alias for county, accepted so missing_facts can be merged into this same tool request. Conflicting duplicate forms are rejected.

home_state.description: Alias for state, accepted so missing_facts can be merged into this same tool request. Conflicting duplicate forms are rejected.

home_zip.description: Alias for zip, accepted so missing_facts can be merged into this same tool request. It must agree with state/home_state when either is supplied; conflicting duplicate forms are rejected.

military_service_state.description: The state the user serves, or served, in. State National Guard doors ("Oklahoma National Guard") need this; without it such a door reads unknown.

military_status.description: User's military affiliation, matched against military field-of-membership (yields eligible_via_military).

occupation.description: User's occupation, matched against trade/industry/profession (TIP) charters.

payroll_city.description: Census-recognized payroll city. Requires payroll_state or a recognized payroll_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

payroll_county.description: County from which the user's employer issues payroll. This is distinct from work_county.

payroll_state.description: Valid state code from which the user's employer issues payroll. This is distinct from work_state.

payroll_zip.description: ZIP from which the user's employer issues payroll. This is distinct from the worksite ZIP.

property_city.description: Census-recognized city where the user owns real property. Requires property_state or a recognized property_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

property_county.description: County where the user owns real property. Distinct from home_county.

property_state.description: State where the user owns real property. Distinct from home_state.

property_zip.description: ZIP where the user OWNS REAL PROPERTY. A door of its own — never inferred from where they live, and an absentee owner qualifies.

relative_association_org_ids.description: Canonical association ids for the relative named by family_relation, never for the applicant.

relative_associations.description: Associations the RELATIVE named by family_relation belongs to. Optional; same unknown-by-default contract as relative_employers.

relative_employer_org_ids.description: Canonical employer ids for the relative named by family_relation, never for the applicant.

relative_employers.description: Employers of the RELATIVE named by family_relation (not the user's own employer). Optional; omitting it leaves compound family doors undecided (unknown), never negative.

relative_memberships.description: Confirmed relative memberships scoped to one exact credit union. A membership at one institution is never reused for another; omit unconfirmed memberships and the corresponding family door remains unknown.

credit_union_id.description: The exact target credit union id.

relation.description: The relative's relationship to the applicant.

relative_school_org_ids.description: Canonical school ids for the relative named by family_relation, never for the applicant.

relative_schools.description: Schools the RELATIVE named by family_relation attends. Optional; same unknown-by-default contract as relative_employers.

school.description: User's school/college/university. Supply school_relationship too; the school name alone does not affirm eligibility.

school_org_ids.description: Canonical school ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities; never populate these from prose extraction.

school_relationship.description: How the user relates to the named school. Required with school to affirm a typed student, alumni, or school-employee path.

state.description: User's valid 50-state/DC code for geographic field-of-membership matching. Lowercase is accepted and normalized.

work_city.description: Census-recognized city where the user works. Requires work_state or a recognized work_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

work_county.description: County where the user works, for work-area membership matching.

work_state.description: Valid 50-state/DC code where the user works, for work-area membership matching. Lowercase is accepted and normalized.

work_zip.description: User's US 5-digit work ZIP or ZIP+4. Resolves to a work county server-side; when work_state is supplied, the crosswalk must agree with it.

worship.description: User's place of worship, matched against worship-org affinity lists (yields likely_eligible).

worship_org_ids.description: Canonical worship-organization ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities.

zip.description: User's US 5-digit ZIP or ZIP+4. Resolves to a county server-side; when state is supplied, the ZIP crosswalk must agree with it.

name: check_membership_eligibility

checked.description: Number of credit unions evaluated in this call, matching the length of `verdicts`.

engine.description: `eligibility_publication_v1` when at least one verdict was decided from an exact active publication; `legacy+graph_shadow` for compatibility output.

note.description: Required caveat that eligibility is guidance from published criteria and the credit union makes the final decision.

summary.description: One-sentence plain-English summary of this result, safe to quote directly to the user.

verdicts.description: One eligibility assessment per credit union requested, in the order supplied.

confidence.description: Confidence in the authoritative graph verdict when exact publication lineage is present; otherwise the legacy record confidence. Forced to 0 when publication authority is unavailable. From 0 to 1.

credit_union_id.description: Internal composite identifier 'name|city|STATE' of the credit union assessed.

details.description: Relative REST API path for the full eligibility record; an API reference, not a page to show the user.

eligibility_type.description: `graph` when a graph carrying exact active-publication lineage is authoritative; otherwise the legacy charter shape such as community, multi, or unknown.

evidence_url.description: Legacy record source page when no published graph authority is present. Omitted beside an authoritative published graph, and when publication authority is unavailable, because a flat URL may back an unrelated or stale path.

graph.description: Deterministic eligibility-graph verdict. Its optional publication binds an authoritative active generation; without publication it is a non-authoritative compatibility shadow. Current unattested negatives are normalized to open-world `unknown` without removing the evaluated credit union.

confidence.description: Confidence in the graph verdict, from 0 to 1.

explain.description: Deterministic human-readable explanation of the verdict.

paths.description: Structured membership-path evaluations. Unattested negatives and alternate paths that did not produce the overall verdict are retained only as actionless `unknown` diagnostics with neutral wording.

conditional_on.description: Action that unlocks a proven conditional path. Present only when both the graph verdict and this path are conditionally_eligible.

conditions_matched.description: Conditions proven on this path. A pending conditional action is never labelled matched; the array resets to empty when a failed or non-winning path is neutralized.

conditions_unknown.description: Conditions still unresolved on a non-negative path. Omitted when a failed path is neutralized.

reason.description: Neutral deterministic explanation of the path outcome.

status.description: Path outcome; reserved `ineligible` instances are normalized to `unknown` without a typed closed-world attestation.

publication.description: Exact immutable active publication evaluated for this verdict.

activated_at.description: When this publication became serving authority.

proposal_coverage.description: Counts of source-page model proposals that were verified, published, or withheld; not a closed-world FOM attestation.

publication_id.description: Database identifier of the active publication.

ruleset_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the publication's complete ordered rule set.

status.description: Five-value wire vocabulary. `ineligible` is reserved for compatibility and is not emitted by MCP without a future typed closed-world attestation.

unknown_reason.description: Machine-readable reason the supplied facts or corpus could not support a positive decision.

matched_rule.description: The specific flat rule that produced a legacy verdict. Omitted when an exact published graph is authoritative because graph paths carry the bound match provenance.

record_confidence.description: Aligned to authoritative graph confidence when exact publication lineage is present; otherwise confidence in the underlying legacy eligibility record. Forced to 0 when publication authority is unavailable. From 0 to 1.

status.description: Machine-readable compatibility outcome. Only a graph carrying exact active-publication lineage is authoritative and conservatively projected here; a publication-less shadow graph cannot replace the flat result. `geo_mismatch` remains reserved and current unattested instances become `unknown`.

unknown_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for `unknown`; `fom_completeness_unaffirmed` means no closed-world membership-corpus attestation exists.

verdict.description: Full user-facing sentence combining the outcome and the reason; the best single field to quote.
